body: Neither -- it is a placeholder. refs.bib's own header says these entries are invented ('None of these exist. Do not cite them'); roe2019placeholder is Roe & Poe in the Review of Imaginary Evidence, no DOI. So it cannot support the frictions/attention claim, and the same holds for doe2020example in the previous sentence. Note the key is also cited at main.tex:60 ('We read this as support for...'), so a real replacement -- or a rewrite of the contrast -- needs to cover both sites. Say the word and I'll source real anchors for both.
